mission.objective: Give a name to a recording ECHO-0 could not name.

completion.description: One of those recordings gets a name from you.

mission.safe_fallback: If nothing like that is within easy reach, skip this mission; it will wait.

wording.text: Give a name to a recording ECHO-0 could not name.

lines.text: I knew what these sounds were called. You showed me what they meant together.
There are sounds I have never met.

facts.statement: The composition uses 3 of the player's recordings.
It is in composed mode, about 120 beats per minute, 24 seconds long.
'Bells' answers 'Bells' in the silence between its notes (fit 0.73).
The lead idea comes back transformed: answer, density, fragment, register, retrograde.
